about: Filtered lens on France for freebie hunting: small hosting providers (hebergeurs) announce trials on their own sites and Discord servers; the precision marker for a claimable no-card trial is 'sans CB'. No feedable French freebie board was found in the scouting or the re-hunt (2026-11-14); the machine layer is thin and the depth sits in the agent-leg hunting grounds.

feeds.name: Korben
feeds.notes: French tech discovery blog for web tools and services; free tools and SaaS coverage is routine (7 of the 17 most recent items mention 'gratuit', checked 2026-11-14). Firehose: read on wake, never a trigger.

feeds.notes: One-curator link blog. Low freebie density (3 of the 50 items in its feed mention 'gratuit', checked 2026-11-14) but high curation quality, occasionally exactly on category (for example free DDNS services). Firehose.

hunting_grounds.how: The habitat of small French hebergeurs: they announce free tiers and trials inside their Discord servers, and the listing is the discovery door. Read the listing, open newly surfaced hosts, and verify any offer at the host's own site before reporting it. The listing page is JavaScript-rendered, so the runner cannot diff it; this ground belongs to the agent leg (browser or search), exactly like the main registry's non-pullable sources. Spotted on the French-filtered listing (checked 2026-11-14): PixelHorizons 100% free community hosting, UniHeberg's 24h free trial 'sans carte bancaire', ARTAUN's 7-day free trial, ASTRALHOST's 3 free days, Vibes Hosting's 24H offered. Listings rotate: Zira Hosting's 'des offres gratuites pour commencer' was spotted on the wider vps tag in 2026-11, so re-spot rather than assume a name is still there.

hunting_grounds.how: Community project that creates free dedicated game servers on machines in France, no subscription and no card, requests by a short form read by humans. Small and games-specific; watch its game pages for new titles.

hunting_grounds.how: Catalogue of France's alternative and associative hosting collective. Harvest the member host list once, then watch the members' own sites for new free services and trials.

local_patterns: Small hebergeurs announce trials on their own sites and Discord servers; DISBOARD (tag vps, French filter) is the discovery door, not a forum feed.
'sans CB' and 'sans carte bancaire' in an offer headline mark a trial that passes a no-card owner filter; treat them as precision boosters in any search.
A source dominated by 'échantillons gratuits' (consumer product samples) is retail class, not a freebie source.
